class.name: ParticipantView
class.brief_description: Displays a [SubViewport] inside a [Control] and passes input to it.
class.description: The [SubViewport] is scaled with the same stretch settings as the root window, from [code]display/window/stretch/*[/code]. Each [code]stretch_[/code] member can override one of them. Set [member stretch_design_size] when the project does not set [code]display/window/size/viewport_width[/code]. [codeblock] var view := ParticipantView.new() view.stretch_mode = ParticipantView.STRETCH_MODE_CANVAS_ITEMS view.stretch_design_size = Vector2i(640, 360) add_child(view) view.set_target(subviewport) [/codeblock] Mouse events are passed to the target at the right position. Keyboard and joypad events are passed only when [member forwards_unhandled_input] is on. Only one view can display a given [SubViewport]. [HostSceneView] is the view a host creates by itself.

method.name: clear_target
method.description: Stops displaying the target and restores its settings. Same as [code]set_target(null)[/code].

method.name: forward_input
method.description: Passes [param event] to the target unchanged.

method.name: get_inner_rect
method.description: Returns where the target is drawn, in local coordinates. The rest of the control is empty letterbox.

method.name: owner_of
method.description: Returns the view displaying [param target], or [code]null[/code].

method.name: set_target
method.description: Displays [param target]. It is set to [constant SubViewport.UPDATE_ALWAYS], and its settings are restored when the view lets go. Fails with an error when another view already displays [param target].

members.member: Whether keyboard and joypad events from [method Node._unhandled_input] are passed to the target.
The resolution the game is designed for. [code]Vector2i(0, 0)[/code] uses [code]display/window/size/viewport_width[/code] and [code]viewport_height[/code].
Like [code]display/window/stretch/scale[/code]. [code]0.0[/code] or less uses the project setting.

constants.constant: No stretching. The target renders at the control's size.
